description_en: Creates an instance group for a specified application
description_zh: 调用InsertDeployGroup接口创建应用分组
name: InsertDeployGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance group. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 分组名称，支持的最大长度为64字符
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The version of the initial deployment package associated with the instance group. You can call the ListHistoryDeployVersion operation to query the version. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149392.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组关联的初始化部署包版本ID。可以调用接口ListHistoryDeployVersion获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149392.html
parameters.name: init_package_version_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

DeployGroupEntity.description_en: The information about the instance group

AppVersionId.description_en:
The version of the deployment package for the application.

If the application is deployed, a string of random numbers is returned.

If the application is not deployed, the return value is empty
AppVersionId.description_zh:
应用部署版本ID。
如果应用部署过，则返回一串随机数。
如果应用未部署，则返回值为空

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance group was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

GroupName.description_en: The name of the instance group

GroupType.description_en:
The type of the instance group. Valid values:

0: the default group.

1: a group for which canary traffic management is not enabled.

2: a group for which canary traffic management is enabled
GroupType.description_zh:
分组类型。
0：默认分组
1：未启用灰度流量管理的分组
2：已启用灰度流程管理的分组

Id.description_en: The ID of the instance group

PackageVersionId.description_en:
The version of the deployment package that was used to deploy an application in the instance group.

If an application is deployed in the instance group, a string of random numbers is returned.

If no application is deployed in the instance group, the return value is empty
PackageVersionId.description_zh:
该分组部署包的版本ID。
如果该应用分组部署过应用，则返回一串随机数。
如果该应用分组未部署过应用，则返回值为空

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the instance group was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
